items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Ed Sullivan was m.c. at that time.

ctx.x: I mean Fletcher was still the biggest.

Oh, are you kidding. Well, nobody was any bigger. We wanted to get to the Duke. ... and '35 and they had the Harvest Moon Ball. Of course, it was free and Ed Sullivan was m.c. at that time. So they had two bands, Henderson's band, our band, and Abe Lyman's band. Now I've seen a lot of things happen in a lot of ways. Sometimes you say ... there were 100,000 people out there. I didn't count them and we struck up the, thought we'd play a little music there, you know, and, Stanley Dance... ... that's the most…
